summary.text: Luke A. Rankin is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 33 in Horry County, serving since 1993.
He chairs the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rankin was born on April 9, 1962, in Horry County and is an attorney.
His official page lists a B.A. from the University of South Carolina in 1984 and a J.D. in 1987.
He has served in the Senate since 1993.
His committee assignments are Banking and Insurance, Education, Ethics, Interstate Cooperation, Judiciary (chairman) and Transportation.
